channel.title: Tunisia - The African Street Journal
channel.description: Daily news from Tunisia, every source cited.

item.title: Tunisia braces for thunderstorms and strong winds
item.description: The National Institute of Meteorology forecasts heavy rain and rough seas across several regions on Sunday, November 1, 2026.

item.title: Tunisia transport attacks cost 4 million dinars
item.description: Attacks on trains, metros, and buses in 2025-2026 damaged property and affected 362 people, according to the transport minister.

item.title: Tunis police arrest 12 for stadium violence
item.description: 12 individuals were arrested in Tunis for alleged involvement in stadium vandalism, theft, and drug offenses.

item.title: Tunis court sentences neighbour to death for child murder
item.description: A young man will be hanged for strangling a six-year-old girl and hiding her body on a neighbour's roof in 2025.

item.title: Tunisia seeks more Arab agricultural investment
item.description: Tunisia's Economy Minister met with the Arab Organization for Agricultural Development president to boost projects.
